page_title: BRE 1-1 REN | Brest v Rennes 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Mama Balde (Brest) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90+3' Jota (Rennes) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
90+1' Yellow card. Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
86' 1 - 1 GOAL! Jota (Rennes) reacts first to the lofted pass and calmly guides the ball into the net with his body.
83' A substitution has been made. Adrien Truffert is replaced by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
83' Mama Balde (Brest) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

64' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the corner.
62' What was Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
61' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Baptiste Santamaria and he is replaced by Glen Kamara (Rennes).
61' It will be a substitution. Jota (Rennes) is ready to enter the pitch as Hans Hateboer walks off.
60' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brest.
56' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
54' 1 - 0 Romain Del Castillo (Brest) gave the goalkeeper no chance from the penalty. Steve Mandanda failed to reach the ball, which slid off the crossbar into the roof of the net.
53' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' Handball by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes). PENALTY to Brest!
51' There's an opportunity for Kenny Lala (Brest) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
50' Looks like Mikayil Faye (Rennes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' A neat pass is well received by Amine Gouiri (Rennes), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
44' 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
42' Jordan Amavi (Brest) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Steve Mandanda to make a comfortable save.
41' OFF THE BAR! Mahdi Camara (Brest) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
39' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
39' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
38' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
37' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) trips an opposition player and Bastien Dechepy signals a foul.
33' Great teamplay by Brest as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' None of the Rennes players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
31' Steve Mandanda (Rennes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
29' The resulting corner from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is cleared by the defence.
27' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
26' The corner from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is intercepted by the defence.
24' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
23' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Hans Hateboer (Rennes).
23' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
21' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest), but Steve Mandanda is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.

18' The cross into the penalty area from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
17' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
16' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
15' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
12' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
9' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) picks up an injury.
9' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Brest control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Good movement by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
